edges.reason: Chest adjacent to iron_block contains 2 diamonds required for diamond hoe recipe
Player must chop spruce_log to get planks, then craft into sticks (2 needed for hoe handle)
Chest near iron_block contains wooden_shovel needed to mine sand efficiently
White wool blocks and poppies (red dye source) are placed beside the lilac garden
Ferns are at the taiga zone entrance where spruce trees stand
Ferns mark the forest/garden path leading northwest to the lilac garden area
Oxeye daisies sit at the plains-to-beach boundary; mining them while walking east reveals the sand beach

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Nearest fern is at spawn-relative (-3, 0, 6), about 6.7 blocks from spawn. Player must navigate to the taiga zone entrance and face the fern within 5 blocks to demonstrate discovery. This rule type was chosen over position_inside_box because the task requires visual observation of a specific object, not just reaching an area.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Iron block is at spawn-relative (0, 0, 5), exactly 5 blocks from spawn. Max distance of 4 ensures the player must walk at least 1 block toward the crafting outpost before the milestone triggers. This rule type correctly models 'player has found and is looking at the iron block'.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Spruce log trunk base is at spawn-relative (-5, 1, 8), about 10 blocks from spawn in the taiga zone. Player must navigate deeper into the taiga and face the spruce tree trunk within 5 blocks. Target y=1 is used so the player looks at trunk height rather than ground level.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Nearest lilac is at spawn-relative (-9, 0, 8), about 12 blocks from spawn in the far west garden area. Player must navigate to the garden and face the lilac within 5 blocks. This discovery also reveals nearby white wool and poppies needed for red_wool crafting.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Brown wool blocks are at spawn-relative (-7, 0, 2), about 7.3 blocks from spawn to the west-southwest. Player must navigate to the wool pen and face it within 5 blocks. This is an independent exploration task with no outgoing dependency edges.

Uses inventory_has because mining an oxeye_daisy (instant break by hand, no tool required) drops the flower item which enters the player's inventory. This is the most direct and reliable check — the mined item must be in inventory. Oxeye daisies are located at the plains-to-beach transition zone (~8 blocks east of spawn).

Uses inventory_has because mining sand drops the sand item into the player's inventory. The wooden_shovel from the chest near iron_block makes this practical (sand breaks in ~0.4s with shovel vs ~0.75s by hand). The inventory check is the definitive proof that sand was successfully mined and collected.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a diamond_hoe places the finished item in the player's inventory. This is a multi-step chain: open chest near iron_block → get 2 diamonds → chop spruce_log with wooden_axe → craft spruce_planks → craft sticks → combine 2 diamonds + 2 sticks in hoe pattern at crafting table. The inventory check captures successful completion of the entire chain.

Uses inventory_has because crafting red_wool places the result in the player's inventory. Multi-step chain: break poppy near lilac garden → craft poppy into red_dye (shapeless, works in 2x2 grid) → break white_wool block near lilacs → combine 1 white_wool + 1 red_dye at crafting table = 1 red_wool. This is the correct Java Edition recipe (only white wool can be dyed). The inventory check verifies the entire crafting chain succeeded.

scene_description: A compact scene with mechanically-enforced dependencies. Player spawns at origin facing north (+Z). A crafting outpost (iron_block + chest with diamonds & shovel + crafting table) is 5 blocks north. A taiga zone with ferns and a spruce tree is 5-8 blocks northwest. A lilac garden with co-located white wool blocks and poppies (red dye source) is 9-10 blocks west. Brown wool is independently placed 7 blocks west-southwest. Oxeye daisies are in the plains-to-beach transition 7-9 blocks east, with a sand beach at 9-14 blocks northeast. Materials are NOT /give'd — they must be found in the scene (diamonds/shovel in chest, sticks from spruce log, red dye from poppies, white wool from placed blocks). Player receives only a wooden_axe (for chopping spruce) and shears (backup tool).
task_text: Explore the forest outpost: find the iron block near the supply chest, locate ferns leading to spruce trees in the taiga, discover lilacs near the wool garden with poppies, find the brown wool pen, mine oxeye daisies and sand from the beach, then craft a diamond hoe and red wool at the crafting station.
design_notes: Scene layout: Player spawns at (0,0,0) facing +Z (north). Crafting outpost at z=5 (iron_block, crafting_table, chest with diamonds+shovel). Taiga zone NW: ferns at (-3,0,6)/(-4,0,7)/(-2,0,7) lead to spruce tree at (-5,0-3,8). Garden area far W: lilacs at (-9,0,8)/(-10,0,7), poppies at (-10,0,5-6)/(-11,0,6), white_wool at (-9,0,4-5). Independent brown_wool at (-7,0,2-3). Plains-beach transition E: oxeye_daisies at (7-9,0,5-7), sand beach at (9-14,-1,9-14). All blocks on flat grass terrain with clear air above — no obstructions. Mechanical gates: diamonds/shovel locked in chest (requires finding iron_block area), sticks require spruce_log chopping (requires finding spruce_wood), red_dye requires poppy crafting (requires finding lilac area with co-located poppies+white_wool).
